Chapter 353: Chapter 12: An Unexpected Conclusion, Controlling The Tianqing World! (Happy New Year)

Chapter 353: Chapter 12: An Unexpected Conclusion, Controlling the Tianqing World! (Happy New Year)

In the deepest parts of the Black Mist Mountain Range.

Qu Zhuang and Liao An were tense.

Their only hope now was that Lin Yuan, wary of the Tianqing Alliance, would not completely turn against them and would spare their lives.

However, Lin Yuan simply sized them up, then released the Demon Tree Seeds and began the parasitism.

Qu Zhuang and Liao An, as elders of the Tianqing Alliance and Sixth Rank powerhouses, barely met Lin Yuan’s ‘parasitic’ criteria.

Moreover, as high-level cultivators of the Tianqing Alliance, they held even greater ‘parasitic’ value.

...

Hum!!!

Two grey seeds fell.

After perfecting the parasitic effect, the Demon Tree Seeds appeared darker, and a mysterious soul force seemed to flow within them.

“Not good.”

“He wants to parasitize us…”

Upon seeing this, the slender elder Qu Zhuang immediately guessed what Lin Yuan intended to do.

As an elder of the Tianqing Alliance, having fought for many years at the Evil God Battlefield, he knew several common tactics used by that Foreign Evil God.

One of these was the parasitic ability, which, although made the human cultivators appear dazed and stiff, allowed them to inherit most of their combat power from before and made them fearsomely courageous.

But most importantly, it impacted the psyche of the cultivators from the Tianqing World.

Once comrades-in-arms, now those who were parasitized turned into fierce attackers…

“It’s useless.”

“Even if you parasitize me, you won’t be able to hide it for long. If we disappear for too long, the alliance’s powerhouses will surely come looking…”

Liao An struggled as he roared quietly.

At that moment, they were strenuously resisting the parasitic ability of the Demon Seeds.

“You think it won’t be hidden for long?”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, without further explanation.

Qu Zhuang and Liao An, along with other Tianqing Alliance elders, were still under the impression that the parasitic ability was at the level of the Ancestral Demon Tree on the Evil God Battlefield.

But Lin Yuan was not the Ancestral Demon Tree. The power of his Demon Seeds’ parasitism, after Lin Yuan had spent decades perfecting it with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, was immeasurably stronger than that of the Ancestral Demon Tree.

In this regard, one need only look at the nearby seven Demon Beast Kings.

Qu Zhuang and Liao An did not realize that the Demon Beast Kings had already been parasitized, thinking instead that they had merely submitted to Lin Yuan.

Rustling.

The Demon Seeds rapidly merged into the foreheads of Liao An and Qu Zhuang.

After a brief struggle, these two Sixth Rank elders.

Immediately stood up and respectfully bowed to Lin Yuan: “Master.”

“Did it work?”

Lin Yuan carefully sensed for a while.

He confirmed that the seeds within the minds of the two had completely integrated.

“Speak, what brings you to the Black Mist Mountain Range, and what is the situation at the Evil God Battlefield?”

Lin Yuan casually asked.

The Divine Ape King had already reported that these two alliance elders were sent by the Tianqing Alliance Leader to recruit the Demon Beast Kings for a counterattack at the Evil God Battlefield.

But Lin Yuan wanted to inquire about more details.

“Master, the Tianqing Alliance Leader has determined that the Foreign Evil God is in an extremely weakened state, hence the decision to launch a counterattack to completely destroy the Evil God Battlefield.”

“For this reason, the Tianqing Alliance Leader has decided to utilize many of the Tianqing World’s resources, such as the Demon Beast Kings of the ten great mountain ranges and certain war machines, among others.”

“These resources, many of which only the Vice Alliance Hierarchs have the authority to mobilize, so this time, the Leader has deployed twelve Vice Hierarchs along with numerous protector elders into the Tianqing World.”

“To quickly assemble the myriad heritage weapons for the counterattack…”

Liao An spoke respectfully in a hushed tone.

After being parasitized by the Demon Seeds, they were not technically deceased but merely ‘replaced,’ so many of their memories remained unaffected.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan nodded, naturally understanding the reason why the Ancestral Demon Tree was in such a weakened state.

“Are you saying that the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs and the protector elders are all within the Tianqing World now?”

Lin Yuan seemed to think of something and asked.

“Yes, Master.”

Liao An and Qu Zhuang exchanged glances and nodded affirmatively.

“I see…”

Lin Yuan stroked his chin, appearing thoughtful.

“Since that is the case… after you two go back out, bring one or two more elders here…”

Lin Yuan spoke.

Now that his stock of Demon Seeds had surged to three hundred, he could certainly parasitize a few more.

…

Outside the Black Mist Mountain Range.

Liao An and Qu Zhuang transformed into streaks of light and flew out.

“Master wants us to bring other elders back… which one should we bring?”

Liao An pondered, glancing at Qu Zhuang.

Though both were Tianqing Alliance elders, Qu Zhuang certainly had a far greater influence and connections than he did.

“I have someone in mind.”

“Follow me.”

Qu Zhuang nodded, immediately heading toward another of the ten great mountain ranges.

…

The Myriad Beasts Mountain Range.

Like the Black Mist Mountain Range, it was one of the ten great mountain ranges of the Tianqing World.

Outside the Myriad Beasts Mountain Range, stood a middle-aged man.

“These Demon Beast Kings, dilly-dallying even after receiving the Leader’s decree… saying they need to prepare…”

This middle-aged man, named Bian Bo, was also one of the elders of the Tianqing Alliance.

This time he had come to the Myriad Beasts Mountain Range to relay the Leader’s decree, ordering the Demon Beast Kings there to join the counterattack at the Evil God Battlefield.

As ‘Bian Bo’ grew impatient,

suddenly, two streaks of Escape Light appeared in the distance.

“Ah, it’s elders Qu Zhuang and Liao An.”

Bian Bo scanned them briefly, then came forward with a smile.

“Brother Bian Bo.”

The slender elder Qu Zhuang responded with a smile.

“How is it? Are these Demon Beast Kings cooperating?”

Qu Zhuang inquired.

“Cooperating?”

“With the Leader’s decree, how dare they not cooperate?”

Bian Bo scoffed, “But these Demon Beast Kings, too indecisive, saying they need a while to prepare…”
